label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparation of a bread-stocked, lantern-lit gathering near the great hall, possibly a surprise associated with the Day 1 18:00 engagement. Innkeeper funded supplies, freight bought and transported them and delivered bread, baker produced bread, and builder installed lanterns and stocked the same containers. The record does not establish the occasion or prove concealment: the mayor was explicitly informed of a great-hall meeting about the inn's service, but no shown communication tells him about these material preparations. Secretary arranged the disclosed appointment and neighbour hosted tea; neither is established as knowingly helping a concealed preparation.
